title: Build a Web3 App - Part 1 - Setting Up Your Environment
summary: n this tutorial series, we'll guide you through the initial steps of setting up your environment to build a Web3 app using the DropChain API.
author: Carter Razink
body:
Welcome to "Build a Web3 App - Part 1 - Setting Up Your Environment" with Carter Razink, CEO and co-founder of DropChain. In this tutorial series, we'll guide you through the initial steps of setting up your environment to build a Web3 app using the DropChain API. This video provides a comprehensive guide, ensuring you have a solid foundation to build upon in the subsequent parts of this series.

‍

Useful Links:

Tutorial App on GitHub: https://github.com/cRazink/dropchain-tutorial-app

DropChain Documentation: https://dropchain.gitbook.io/dropchain-documentation/

Create an Account on DropChain: https://console.dropchain.network/login

Quickstart Guide: https://dropchain.gitbook.io/dropchain-quickstart-guide/

Join DropChain Discord Community: https://discord.gg/atVcDr6YZt

‍

What You Will Learn:

- Setting up your environment for building a Web3 app.

- Utilizing the DropChain API for various functionalities.

- Managing API keys securely and efficiently.

- Testing basic transactions and ensuring a smooth setup.
